answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by requiring each identity to stake a terrain-relative Doppler dead-reckoning track whose pairwise LBL fixes must stay mutually consistent across the fleet. Like walnut shells sealing a hull, timber bracing a tundra survey camp, each node's track is cross-checked against SAS beamformed returns, so duplicate identities diverge. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
